Name: Walk to Garden Village
Author: mikemonroe
Description:
UPDATE 07/06/2020:

Now the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6234]Walk to the Desert[/url] expansion mod that adds another way to access the shops has been released﻿.[b] [/b]I'm still leaving this mod up for people who do not use the Walk to the Desert expansion.

-----

Currently the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6113]Garden Village Shops[/url]﻿ mod doesn't have a non-cheat way to access the shops before repairing the bus. This mod adds warps from the bus stop map to the village and back.

Just walk on the asphalt road to the right edge of the map on the bus stop to get to Garden Village, and walk back to return.

Should be compatible with vanilla, SVE, Stray Catfe, and Boarding House.

Downloads.Description: This is a version that doesn't need TMXL or PyTK, and it should work with both releases of Garden Village.
